title: Workspace Semantic Execution Backend v1
goal: Implement the first production-grade modular-monolith backend for Workspace Semantic Execution: a pure executor-agnostic domain kernel, deterministic packet compilation, typed executor/resource routing, durable runtime/state ports, provisional DBOS+PostgreSQL adapters, exact CandidateAction-to-ActionSpec authority compilation, EffectReceipt/postcondition validation, event-driven waits, and a real Research Engine shadow canary—without replacing GitRunner, Research Engine, Operator Bridge, project-local truth, or existing authority owners.
acceptance_criteria: The production domain kernel has no dependency on DBOS, PostgreSQL, GitHub, browser/UI, model-provider SDKs, GPU libraries, or other infrastructure adapters.
Production kernel behavior satisfies the validated parent executable reference contract at workspace-control@6b27e9c057c6ea33fdf532112711a11e10ff3723.
Stale generations cannot mutate or complete current work; at most one current lease owns a process generation; dependency readiness fails closed until all required dependencies are COMPLETED.
Effect execution is idempotent: identical duplicate receipts are no-ops and conflicting duplicates fail closed.
No action reaches COMPLETED from tool/executor success alone; completion requires EffectReceipt plus passing postcondition ValidationResult evidence.
WAITING_EXTERNAL and dependency waits release worker leases and consume no model-polling quanta.
CandidateAction and all model output are non-authoritative; ActionSpec compilation requires an explicit exact-scope AuthorityDecision=ALLOW and cannot widen scope.
Unknown state, transition, executor capability, authority outcome, or incompatible session/resource requirement fails closed.

Worker packets are deterministically reproducible from typed durable state, DecisionRecords, constraints, evidence refs, authority refs, validator contracts and executor profile; no second LLM is required merely to write routine prompts.
Executor identity is provider + model + surface + harness + toolset + capability/resource/session profile, not model name alone.

The same generic ReasoningProcess can be represented for human-assisted persistent ChatGPT Instant sessions and future fully programmatic stateless/session-scoped/persistent/batch institutional LLM executors without workflow-schema changes.
The control plane is GPU-blind by default and introduces no CUDA/GPU dependency; heavy compute remains an explicit separately leased executor.
DBOS+PostgreSQL is tested only behind DurableRuntimePort/StateStorePort and remains provisional until Architecture Review v0.3.
The first effect adapter is read-only or low-consequence and verifies exact postconditions after tool success.

A frozen real Research Engine workflow shape is replayed through the production kernel, then a read-only/shadow integration canary observes actual Research Engine state without mutating research-engine.

Crash/fault tests cover death after claim, death after effect before checkpoint, duplicate/delayed/out-of-order events, stale generations, executor/session loss, validator timeout, and durable recovery.
The current GitRunner/controller remains untouched except as a future adapter/dependency; no controller redesign or authority widening is performed by this task.
The current Operator Bridge remains independently owned; this task may define its backend action/status port but does not change browser automation or real-account promotion gates.

Architecture Review v0.3 is performed after the first real backend workflow using traces, faults, resource measurements, and implementation friction before freezing DBOS/PostgreSQL/semantic-graph physical choices.
constraints: Do not mutate research-engine in this first backend task; it is a read-only real-workflow canary source until separately authorized.
Do not mutate controller/lambda-ci-controller, GitRunner policies, provisioner/runtime state, or GitRunner task authority.
Do not mutate operator-bridge/** or widen its ChatGPT/browser interaction authority.
Do not put hot runtime leases, generations, retries, sessions, waits, or ready queues into Git/GitHub.
Do not introduce Kafka, Redis, Neo4j, a vector database, Kubernetes, microservices, a general agent framework, or a local LLM dependency in the first vertical slice.
Do not make DBOS, PostgreSQL, a graph database, a specific model, a specific provider, or a specific worker count part of the domain model.
Do not allow model inference, semantic projection, executor selection, or semantic graph edges to grant/widen execution authority.
Do not treat persistent chat memory as required for correctness; durable typed state must support stateless resume.
Do not fabricate executor capability, quota, resource availability, model context limits, or institutional GPU allocation; unknown remains UNKNOWN and fails/defers according to policy.
Do not consume reasoning/model quanta while waiting for CI, experiments, human decisions, resources, or other external events.
Do not use the control plane's local GPU; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES must be empty in resource-budget validation.
Do not replace accepted Research Engine orchestration semantics merely because generic kernel primitives overlap; adapt incrementally and preserve rollback.
Do not broaden mutation paths beyond this capsule's allowed scope without a new explicit authority boundary.

Runtime-port implementation resumes only from this corrected boundary.

Fault coverage includes stale writer, event-before-wait, restart while waiting, duplicate event, generation recovery and stale executor completion. The design remains database/runtime independent. 2026-11-13 DBOS+POSTGRES FIRST SUBSTRATE SPIKE VALIDATED: exact head workspace-control@8e8caf543cff000275bd2cf543f57f89ad9ff3e5 passed Workspace Control #2722 and Semantic Execution #7. The spike pins DBOS Python 3.5.0 + psycopg 3.3.9 and separates DurableRuntimePort (bounded idempotent work) from EventLedgerPort (external wake evidence). PostgreSQL provides deterministic JSONB current-state CAS plus immutable wake-event evidence. DBOS work IDs are idempotent and stored workflow inputs are verified to reject conflicting reuse. A hard-kill subprocess probe exited via os._exit while a workflow was RUNNING and a fresh process recovered/completed that exact workflow from PostgreSQL. Semantic external waits deliberately do not use DBOS.recv. DBOS+PostgreSQL is therefore the provisional first substrate, still behind ports and still reversible until Architecture Review v0.3.
